name: Cleveland State University
academic_ranking: Public R2 doctoral university (Carnegie: High research activity). U.S. News & World Report 2025 ranked CSU #342 (tie) nationally and #183 among public national universities; Forbes #196; Washington Monthly #217.
financial_aid: In-state undergraduate tuition and required fees approximately $12,988/year and out-of-state approximately $18,510/year (2024-25, per NCES/IPEDS). Total cost of attendance (on campus) roughly $32,792 in-state and $38,314 out-of-state. Athletic scholarships and need/merit-based aid available; contact the CSU Office of Financial Aid for specifics.
facilities_notes: Vikings softball competes as an NCAA Division I program in the Horizon League. Staff directory and roster verified via csuvikings.com 2026-07; no detailed public facilities description captured from the fetched pages.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the Horizon League, based in Cleveland, Ohio.
